not_modeled.note: Permanently out of scope in this product line until a future version explicitly adds it. The plan counts the first meetings the bookings target implies. Nothing here proves the funded engines will produce them. Engine spend is not converted into meetings or bookings.

plg.reason: No self-serve surface. Revisit when a free tier or trial exists.

manual_outbound.reason: ACV clears the bar for tiered, rep-led outbound. The deep-dive program is the operating manual. Already running per your intake; this verdict applies to continued funding.

abm.reason: Enterprise ACV and reps to route to: named list, signal architecture, stage scoring.
abm.label: ABM

community_partner.reason: Partner lane only: marketplace listing plus two or three co-sell relationships; the 25 percent channel bar is the graduation gate.
community_partner.label: Community + Partner Led

paid_media.reason: Qualifies on ICP and budget, but the split funds it at $1,932 a month against its own $8,000 floor: below the learning threshold, paid spend fragments across audiences and teaches nothing. Not funded this cycle; raise the pipeline budget or concentrate it here deliberately.
paid_media.label: Paid Media

seo_aeo.reason: Start the clusters and versus pages now; the flywheel pays months from now (see the source registry for the conversion claim).
seo_aeo.label: SEO + AEO

social_content.reason: Three founder posts a week plus daily comments; capture engaged accounts into outbound.
social_content.label: Social Content

events.reason: Qualifies on ICP and budget, but the split funds it at $4,250 a month against its own $15,000 floor: below a sponsorship-grade program, the spend buys a booth and no pipeline. Not funded this cycle; raise the pipeline budget or concentrate it here deliberately.
events.label: Events
